verdict: Instagram lead generation is producing leads at nearly double the industry cost, with weak call volume for peak heating season.
diagnosis: You spent $12,255 for 104 leads this period — about $118 per lead — while industry benchmarks sit between $51 and $90.

signals.headline: 104 leads at $118 each
signals.detail: Cost per lead runs well above the $51–$90 range most HVAC contractors see on paid channels this year.

signals.headline: 91 phone calls from Google profile
signals.detail: Averages roughly 3 calls per day — low for October, which is typically the busiest HVAC service month.

signals.headline: 190 direction requests, 0 bookings
signals.detail: Strong local search interest is not converting into booked jobs through your profile.

signals.headline: 294 new reviews, 5-star average
signals.detail: Review velocity is excellent and is your single strongest competitive asset right now.

signals.headline: 3,592 clicks, 1,458 link clicks
signals.detail: Less than half of ad clicks reach your site — suggests form drop-off or slow load after tap.

benchmark.label: BENCHMARK
benchmark.body: Google Local Services Ads averaged $51 per HVAC lead in 2026 across 888 contractors. Blended Google Ads sits near $85. Your $118 per Instagram lead runs above both channels.

seasonal.label: SEASONAL
seasonal.subheader: October is peak HVAC service month
seasonal.body: Industry trip data shows October is the busiest HVAC month as furnaces reactivate and break down. First cold fronts drive urgent repair calls across heating equipment that sat idle all summer.

competitor.label: COMPETITOR
competitor.body: Carrier assumes flat residential volumes in 2026 and sticker shock is pushing homeowners toward repairs over $12K replacements. Financing offers and tune-up entry points are winning share this season.

recommendations.title: Test Google Local Services Ads alongside Instagram
recommendations.detail: Local Services Ads average $51 per HVAC lead nationally. Worth testing a small budget shift to see if your cost per lead drops at similar volume.

recommendations.title: Audit the furnace form drop-off
recommendations.detail: Only 1,458 of 3,592 clicks became link clicks. Consider checking page load speed, form length, and whether the financing offer is visible above the fold.

recommendations.title: Lead heating ads with tune-up offer
recommendations.detail: October furnace breakdowns drive urgent calls. Test a low-cost tune-up ad as an entry point, with financing on the install as the upsell.
